groups.comparison: Exact P16 autoresolve2879 and classification65 fully read, including test bodies without running them. F136 owns conditional log attack payload, F137 records three valid armor contact states. Yielded history and current physical incapacitation are independent: both may coexist and outcome gives yielded terminal-cause precedence; never replace with an exclusive healthy/yielded/incapacitated enum that drops facts. Aggregate incapacitation and detailed components are derived together at outcome snapshot; no ordinary stale outcome claim. BattleOpening already owns exclusive Normal/AlliesSurprise/EnemiesSurprise, and awareness is not rerolled. classify_battle_resolution receives immediate named predicates, not retained modes; empty side is intentionally defeated. Transient attack start/contact/measure Options, engagement target/distance and telemetry defense tuples remain candidates requiring child writer traces; do not assume all Options must be Some together. Recovery-until survives canceled attack and is meaningful independent history. AttackEffect.hit differs from positive damage: ToDefender counts as contact hit even when armor absorbs all; a false contact carries zero health damage on reached producer. Summary counters are event aggregates, not exclusive modes; no enum of arbitrary round/index/count. Tests preserve fixed seeds, stable side-independent contact ordering, ranged/melee switching, general fatigue and one encumbrance contribution. All child scheduling/defense/weapon schemas need their own reads.
groups.disposition: F136/F137 payload suggestions; independent combat history and actual outcome predicates preserved
